files.typeNotAllowed: {{name}} can't be attached. Use PDF, images, Office files, text, CSV, ZIP or email files.
files.tooMany: Attach up to {{max}} files at a time.

savedReplies.title: Saved replies
savedReplies.intro: Write common answers once and insert them into any reply. Team replies are shared with everyone working that team.

newTicket.title: New request
newTicket.intro: Tell us what you need. Your request goes straight to the right team.
newTicket.noDesks: No service desks are open to you yet. Ask an administrator to set one up.
newTicket.requesterHelp: Leave empty to raise it for yourself
newTicket.subject: Subject
newTicket.descriptionHelp: Include what you tried, error messages and since when it happens

tickets.emptyRequests: You have no requests here. Use New request to raise one.

ticket.created: Request {{id}} created. You'll get replies here.
ticket.noteHelp: Only support staff can see internal notes
ticket.closedNotice: This request is closed. Raise a new request if you still need help.
ticket.transferHelp: Move this ticket from {{team}} to another team. The assignee is cleared so the new team can pick it up.
ticket.transferredAway: Ticket transferred. It now belongs to a team you don't work in.
ticket.deleteHelp: Use this for spam, test tickets or duplicates. The requester no longer sees it; team leads can restore it.

desks.title: Service desks
desks.intro: A service desk is where people raise requests, such as IT Help or HR Help. Categories decide which team gets each request.
desks.needTeams: Create at least one team on the Organization page first. Tickets are worked by teams.
desks.noCategories: No categories yet. People can't raise requests here until you add one.
desks.name: Name
desks.codeHelp: 2–10 capital letters or digits. Ticket numbers start with it, for example IT-1001
desks.categoryDescriptionHelp: Shown to people when they pick this category
desks.defaultTeamHelp: Gets requests whose category has no team of its own
desks.autoCloseHelp: If the requester does not reply. 0 never closes them automatically.

users.title: Users
users.intro: Everyone who can sign in: employees, customers and support staff. Give support staff roles on the Organization page.
users.name: Name
users.typeHelp: Employees and customers raise requests; staff work tickets once they have a role

setup.title: Set up VueTicket
setup.intro: Create your organization and the first administrator. You can add business units, departments and teams afterwards.
setup.organizationCodeHelp: Capital letters and digits, for example ACME
setup.passwordHelp: At least 10 characters, with a letter and a number
setup.done: Your organization is ready. Sign in with the administrator account.

home.noAccess: You have no roles yet. Ask an administrator to give you one.

org.title: Organization
org.intro: Business units, departments and teams. Tickets belong to teams; roles are given on a unit.
org.selectUnit: Select a unit to see its details and who has roles on it.
org.noAssignments: Nobody has a role on this unit yet.
org.name: Name
org.searchPeople: Search by name, username or email
org.applyToSubUnits: Also applies to every unit below this one

roles.title: Roles
roles.intro: A role is a set of permissions. Give it to people on a part of the organization from the Organization page.
roles.name: Role name
roles.lockedHelp: The System Admin role can't be changed. Copy it to make your own version.

sla.title: Service levels
sla.pausedSince: Paused since {{when}} while waiting for the requester.
sla.escalationNext: Moves to the next level at {{when}} if still not handled.
sla.noOwner: no one in that role (system admins notified)

calendars.title: Calendars & holidays
calendars.intro: Business hours decide when SLA clocks run. A team uses its own calendar, or the nearest one above it, or the default.
calendars.name: Name
calendars.usedByDefault: Used by every unit without its own calendar
calendars.makeDefault: Default calendar for the whole organization
calendars.appliesNote: Changes apply to SLA targets set from now on. Tickets already running keep their current due times.
calendars.holidayListsIntro: Days when SLA clocks stop. Attach a list to any calendar.

slaPolicies.title: SLA policies
slaPolicies.intro: Response and resolution targets per priority, and who a ticket escalates to when a target is missed.
slaPolicies.name: Name
slaPolicies.targetsHelp: In business time, counted on the team's calendar.
slaPolicies.escalateWhen: Escalate when this target is missed
slaPolicies.escalateHelp: Missed targets always notify the assignee and team lead. Escalation also hands the ticket up the hierarchy.
slaPolicies.finalLevel: Final level: reminded every 4 business hours until handled.
slaPolicies.levelsHelp: Each level goes to the nearest person holding that role above the ticket's team.
slaPolicies.matching: The most specific active policy wins: desk and type, then desk, then type, then all desks.
slaPolicies.appliesNote: Changes apply to new tickets. Tickets already running keep the targets they started with.

unitSettings.title: Hours & assignment
unitSettings.intro: Which business hours each unit works, and how each team's new tickets are assigned.
unitSettings.limits: Up to {{max}} open per agent · alert after {{alert}} min unassigned
unitSettings.hoursHelp: Units below this one use the same hours unless they set their own.
unitSettings.noCalendarRights: You cannot change business hours here.
unitSettings.noRoutingRights: You cannot change assignment for this team.

modeHelp.LoadBalanced: New tickets go to the available agent with the fewest open tickets.
modeHelp.RoundRobin: New tickets go to available agents in turn.
modeHelp.Manual: Nobody is assigned automatically; leads assign from the Unassigned queue.

unitSettings.maxOpenHelp: Agents at this limit are skipped.
unitSettings.alertHelp: Team leads are alerted when a ticket waits this long.
unitSettings.appliesNote: The engine picks up changes within two minutes.

dashboard.nothingAssigned: Nothing assigned to you. Pick something from the Unassigned queue.
dashboard.flowSummary: {{created}} tickets created and {{resolved}} resolved in the last 14 days
dashboard.noAgents: No agents receive work in these teams yet.
dashboard.noRequests: You have not raised any requests yet.

engine.title: Engine
engine.intro: The background worker that runs SLA timers, escalations, assignment, auto-close and email. See when each task last ran and what it did.
engine.neverRan: The engine has not reported yet. Start the worker (TicketCore.Worker) and this page fills in within a few seconds.

taskHelp.sla-events: Starts, pauses and meets SLA clocks from ticket changes
taskHelp.assignment: Assigns new tickets to available agents
taskHelp.unassigned-watch: Alerts leads about tickets nobody picked up
taskHelp.auto-close: Closes resolved tickets after the desk's wait time

engine.logHelp: Runs that did something or failed, newest first. Idle runs only update the task list above. Kept for 30 days.
engine.noRuns: Nothing has happened yet. Runs appear here when the engine acts on a ticket or a run fails.
engine.noErrors: No failures in the kept history.
